short_description:
Two Red Dead Redemption easter eggs in GTA 6: Arthur Morgan's 'Genuine Cowboy Hat' at a yard sale in southern Port Gellhorn (from Chapter 2; guides list different prices), and a Western novel about a cowboy from New Austin inside Jacob's Tavern in Millport. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #19 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: GamesRadar, TheGamer, Dexerto, Game8, Red Bull, GameSpot, The Click.
